evidence_policy: Two default positive full-field cases with explicit partial allowance; matched absence is not recovered content. No complete plugin contract is claimed.
known_limitations: Only explicitly mapped Win10 15063+ x64 builds; no x86/ARM64 or older-build implementation.
No PID option, matching the reference requirements.
Offset follows pinned renderer pointer-object storage semantics after the first row; actual record addresses remain in diagnostics.
Parameters, ImagePath and ServiceDll use pinned exact-case checks, even when Windows registry names would otherwise be case-insensitive.
Registry corrupt siblings and missing regf base blocks retain partial diagnostics; damaged index lists or duplicate target names cannot establish a complete registry view.
Hive pool-scan fallback when both hive-list directions fail remains unimplemented.
Services are anchored in the first services.exe image VAD; there is no equivalence claim for every services.exe variant or manipulated VAD.
No actual malicious hidden-service or intentionally cyclic service-list image validated.
Bounds are 128 MiB executable VAD scan and 65536 records per chain. Cycles/missing pages are partial, never clean absence.
Registry process view errors may leave missing registry fields; fallback to the kernel view is only available when process-memory initialization fails.
synthetic_tests: eleven fields, Order zero/bounds, running process/driver/stopped records
aligned headers, range scope, duplicate chains, pointer-storage Offset semantics
cycles, independent field faults, missing pages and cancellation
UTF-16 byte order, embedded/trailing NUL, malformed data
unsupported builds/PID, corrupt sibling recovery and exact-name service values
